title: CAT(0) spaces without linear filling at the asymptotic rank
summary: For every integer $ν\geq 2$, we construct a $(ν+1)$-dimensional, locally compact, geodesically complete CAT(0) space of asymptotic rank $ν$ which does not satisfy a linear isoperimetric inequality for integral $ν$-cycles. Its filling function is bounded below by $c v\log v$ for all sufficiently large $v$.
